top_signals.title: Bond Market’s ‘Extreme’ Short Counts on Fed to Deliver Hike
top_signals.summary:
Bond traders have piled into bearish positions ahead of Wednesday’s Federal Reserve meeting, betting that the Treasury selloff driving yields to their highest in almost two decades will continue. 
Steven Major, Global Macro Advisor at Tradition, discusses the case for a bond rally and falling yields. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure
top_signals.summary: Bernstein said the federal agencies will publish new regulations to compensate for the time lost negotiating the CLARITY Act, after its cloture vote failed on Tuesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is getting a makeover as it prepares for its 'next 3,000' locations
top_signals.summary: Tropical Smoothie Cafe unveiled new branding as it grows rapidly under the ownership of private equity firm Blackstone.
